years_since_diagnosis.evidence: diagnosed with Crohn's seven years ago

location.evidence: Colonoscopy revealed severe Crohn's throughout colon and terminal ileum.

severity.evidence: Described as 'severe Crohn's' at diagnosis; currently on Humira with only ~50% improvement and GI considering adding methotrexate; prior biologic failure. Ongoing significant symptoms suggest at least moderate-to-severe.

disease_control.evidence: Currently on Humira but not as effective. Maybe 50% improvement.

treatments.reason_stopped: Sent blood sugars through roof; contributed to osteoporosis over years
treatments.evidence: Prednisone and azathioprine combo. Prednisone sent blood sugars through roof.

treatments.reason_stopped: Liver enzymes started climbing after about two years
treatments.evidence: Azathioprine helped for about two years. Then liver enzymes started climbing. Had to stop.

treatments.reason_stopped: Developed antibodies; stopped working completely within weeks
treatments.evidence: Switched to Remicade... Worked well for three years... Then developed antibodies. Stopped working completely within weeks.
Tried Humira next. Currently on it but not as effective. Maybe 50% improvement.
GI wants to add methotrexate. Worried about liver. Already damaged from diabetes meds and previous Crohn's treatment.

encounters.evidence: After three months, finally saw doctor. Colonoscopy revealed severe Crohn's throughout colon and terminal ileum.
Started aggressive treatment immediately... Switched to Remicade... Tried Humira next. Currently on it... GI wants to add methotrexate.

status.evidence: Tried Humira next. Currently on it but not as effective.

barriers.evidence: Insurance fought it hard. Six months of appeals while suffering. Finally approved. (referring to Remicade, the first biologic)

referral_steps_gp_to_prescriber.evidence: GP/doctor visit -> GI specialist who prescribed biologics. Two steps.

extraction_notes: Insulin is excluded from treatments as it was needed to manage diabetes worsened by prednisone, not as a Crohn's treatment. Osteoporosis, type 2 diabetes, and hypertension recorded as comorbidities. Nutritional supplements and protein shakes excluded (not IBD treatments). Clinical trial mentioned as upcoming discussion but no drug name given; not added to treatments. Methotrexate included as a proposed/not-yet-started treatment. The GI encounter covers both the initial aggressive treatment and all subsequent biologic decisions as one continuing provider relationship.
